description: describeStatus(input.status, {locale: input.locale}), or describeServiceStatus(input.service, {locale: input.locale}) for a case with input.service (MCPWARP.md §6A.9), must return exactly expect (detail absent when not listed). A case with input.service, or whose input.status carries services, is host-only per rules.json hostOnlyCases and skipped by SDK runners. Rules in rules.json; tables in <locale>.json. A locale of null means the option is absent.
